classes.name: ChiseiContextReference
classes.description: An existing, authorization-filtered Chisei planning or execution reference whose source remains authoritative outside the projection.

classes.name: ChiseiEpistemicDescriptor
classes.description: A bounded, read-only chisei.epistemic-descriptor/v1 projection over an existing Chisei or Sekai reference that keeps origin, evidence, and lifecycle dimensions separate; it carries no source payload and is not durable epistemic authority.

properties.name: contract_version
properties.description: Projection semantics identifier: chisei.epistemic-descriptor/v1.

properties.name: origin_class
properties.description: Closed origin dimension: asserted, derived, hypothesis, or unknown.

properties.name: evidence_status
properties.description: Closed evidence dimension: supported, contested, insufficient, or unknown.

properties.name: lifecycle_status
properties.description: Closed lifecycle dimension: current, stale, retracted, superseded, or unknown.

classes.name: ChiseiContextAdmissionPolicy
classes.description: A versioned, opt-in Chisei policy that governs use of already-authorized epistemic context projections without adjudicating their truth or changing their source lifecycle.

properties.name: contract_version
properties.description: Policy semantics identifier: chisei.context-admission/v1.

properties.name: default_action
properties.description: Action used when a complete descriptor matches no rule.

properties.name: unknown_action
properties.description: Bounded action used when descriptor dimensions or confidence basis are unknown.

properties.name: rules_json
properties.description: Canonical bounded first-match rule set.

classes.name: ChiseiContextAdmissionDecision
classes.description: A bounded decision record describing how a configured Chisei context-admission policy treated an authorized descriptor before enrichment or provider execution.

properties.name: action
properties.description: Include, qualify, hold_out, require_review, or require_verification.

properties.name: policy_version
properties.description: Content hash of the policy that produced the decision.

properties.name: descriptor_version
properties.description: Descriptor contract version used for the decision.

properties.name: reason_code
properties.description: Bounded, non-content-bearing reason code.

classes.name: ChiseiKiokuMemory
classes.description: A versioned, namespace-scoped Chisei institutional memory whose active version remains immutable when governed evidence is reassessed; successor candidates require human review.

properties.name: contract_version
properties.description: Memory contract identifier: kioku.memory/v1.

properties.name: lifecycle_state
properties.description: Candidate, active, superseded, or rejected memory lifecycle state.

properties.name: evidence_basis_digest
properties.description: Digest of the canonical exact evidence basis used by a reassessment candidate.

properties.name: reassessment_key
properties.description: Bounded idempotency key for an evidence reassessment.

classes.name: ChiseiKiokuEvidenceBasis
classes.description: An identity-and-digest-only snapshot of one admitted evidence item used to recalculate a Kioku successor candidate; the source submission remains authoritative.

properties.name: evidence_reference
properties.description: Exact source evidence reference.

properties.name: evidence_digest
properties.description: Exact content digest for the referenced evidence.

properties.name: source_submission_id
properties.description: Authoritative admitted evidence submission identity when newly attached.

properties.name: lifecycle_state
properties.description: Admitted evidence lifecycle state at reassessment.

properties.name: stance
properties.description: Supporting or contradicting relation to the memory claim.

classes.name: SekaiGraphProjectionReference
classes.description: An authorization-filtered asserted graph fact or query-time ontology derivation returned by an existing Sekai retrieval surface.

classes.name: SekaiEvidenceProjectionReference
classes.description: An admitted external evidence submission or retained evidence projection whose lifecycle and source identity remain authoritative outside the descriptor.

classes.name: SekaiScenarioHypothesisReference
classes.description: A request-scoped, non-durable scenario impact projection that remains a hypothesis and cannot promote evidence status.

relations.name: describes_existing_context_reference
relations.description: Associates a read-only descriptor projection with an existing context reference without transferring source authority.

relations.name: projects_authorized_graph_reference
relations.description: Associates a descriptor with an existing authorization-filtered graph fact or ontology derivation projection.

relations.name: projects_admitted_evidence_reference
relations.description: Associates a descriptor with an existing admitted evidence submission projection while preserving source lifecycle and identity.

relations.name: projects_scenario_hypothesis_reference
relations.description: Associates a descriptor with an existing request-scoped scenario hypothesis projection.

relations.name: governs_context_admission
relations.description: Associates a configured context-admission policy with the read-only descriptor projection it evaluates.

relations.name: records_context_admission_decision
relations.description: Associates a bounded context-admission decision with the descriptor projection and policy versions used to produce it.

relations.name: supersedes_kioku_memory_version
relations.description: Associates a reviewable Kioku successor candidate with the exact prior memory version it may supersede after human promotion.

relations.name: binds_kioku_evidence_basis
relations.description: Associates a Kioku memory version with each bounded exact evidence-basis snapshot used to derive its support and uncertainty.
